name: Carlos Prates

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (ufcstats: 73 in, 78 in reach, stance listed as Switch)

face.shape: Long oval face that tapers from high, defined cheekbones to a narrow, pointed, projecting chin, so the lower face reads as an inverted triangle. Clearly longer than wide and lean, with slight hollows under the cheekbones.
face.jaw: Narrow to medium, with defined but light angles that taper steeply to the chin; visible under light stubble.
face.chin: Narrow, prominent and slightly long; in left profile (UFC 322 face-off) it projects forward of the lower lip. Carries a small goatee.
face.cheekbones: High and defined; cheeks below are flat to slightly hollow.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the eyes sit a little deep under straight, low brows.
face.forehead: Medium height, fairly broad and smooth, with a faint horizontal crease.

eyes.shape: Almond with heavy, hooded upper lids that cover the top of the iris, giving a calm, half-lidded look; outer corners slightly down; mild bags beneath.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, close to the eyes, angled slightly down at the outer ends; normal gap.

nose.width: Narrow-to-medium bridge widening to a broad lower nose.
nose.tip: Broad and rounded, very slightly upturned so the nostrils show a little from the front.

mouth.upper_lip: Full, with a clear cupid's bow, framed by the thin moustache.
mouth.lower_lip: Full and wide; the most prominent feature of the lower face.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed and relaxed, corners slightly down.

ears.protrusion: Stand slightly out from the head; easy to see above the skin fade.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No. The folds are well defined in the April 2026 studio stance and the May 2026 fight photo.
ears.notes: Ordinary ears with a slight stand-out.

face.notable_marks_scars: A small dark spot on the left cheek beside the nose (April 2026 headshot; a mole or small mark). Heavy tattooing on the throat, neck and scalp (see tattoos). No visible facial scars.

hair.style: Short black tight curls on top, about 3 cm, over a high skin fade on the sides and back; neat, straight front hairline. No part, no fringe. The faded left side shows a large blackletter scalp tattoo.
hair.colour: Black (very dark brown in bright light).
hair.hairline: Straight across the forehead with slightly receding temple corners; dense on top.

facial_hair.density: Sparse: a thin moustache and a small chin goatee over a faint stubble shadow on the jaw and upper neck.
facial_hair.length_mm: 2-5 mm (moustache and goatee); stubble about 1 mm
facial_hair.shape: Thin pencil moustache along the upper-lip edge, the ends dropping slightly past the mouth corners; a small goatee/soul patch under the lower lip and on the chin point. Same look in the April 2026 studio headshot and the April 2026 interview frame.

tone_samples.light: dim indoor, under a cap brim
dim indoor, under a cap brim

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the five samples marked in_average (three studio cheeks, two daylight cheeks); each sample is the median of a small well-lit patch
skin.tone_hex_recommended_method: 60% face average + 40% torso average (ESPN studio light)
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles. Most of the arms, chest, back, neck and the left side of the scalp are tattooed.

body.build: Tall, rangy and long-limbed for welterweight: 6 ft 1 in with a 78 in reach (+5 in ape index), so the arms look very long.
body.body_fat_notes: Defined six-pack and obliques with little body fat in the April 2026 studio stance and the May 2026 fight photo.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad but not bulky; lean, rounded deltoids.
body.arms: Very long and wiry, with lean upper arms and forearms; slim arms covered by full sleeves.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with slim thighs and slim calves; light dark leg hair.
body.posture: Upright and loose, with the head a little forward and the chin slightly raised in the stance portrait; relaxed shoulders.
body.notable_physique_traits: Very long arms and legs, narrow waist, slim build, dense tattoo coverage on the arms, chest, back and neck.

tattoos.where: Right arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey sleeve: a winged cherub/baby face with a halo on the outer upper arm and shoulder, cursive script including 'One life' on the front of the upper arm, a horned devil-like face on the forearm, with shading filling the gaps.

tattoos.where: Left arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: A Japanese oni/hannya-style mask with red eyes on the shoulder and deltoid inside a rope border, a woman's face in black and grey on the upper arm, red flowers/leaves around the elbow, black-and-grey work on the forearm.

tattoos.where: Upper and middle back, the whole back
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey back piece under big blackletter lettering arched across the shoulders, consistent with 'NIGHTMARE' (only 'NI...' at his left shoulder and '...are' at his right are legible in these photos; EssentiallySports gives the back text as 'The Nightmare'). The letters are left as skin colour on dark shading. Below: a grinning Joker/clown face across the centre-right, a second clown face on the left, a joker playing card and roses lower down.
tattoos.size: About 45 x 45 cm, shoulders to waist

tattoos.where: Upper chest, across both pecs below the collarbones
tattoos.description: 'Muay Thai' in large cursive script with flourishes, black.
Ornate blackletter monogram in black, centred on the throat.

tattoos.where: Left side of the neck, from the collarbone up toward the jaw
tattoos.description: Three or four lines of cursive script in black; the lines read partly as '...thing / can / stop me' in the face-off profile (EssentiallySports gives 'Nothing can stop me').

tattoos.where: Left side of the scalp, over and behind the left ear
tattoos.description: Large arched blackletter script in black, visible through the high fade (EssentiallySports gives 'Predestinado'; not legible in these photos). Not visible on the right side.
'DANGER' in large vertical black brush-style capitals running down the shin.

tattoos_note: Placement checked against the un-mirrored April 2026 studio stance (the 'Muay Thai', DANGER and UFC text read correctly), the UFC 322 face-off (left side) and the UFC Perth fight photo (right side). The right thigh and right leg look clear in the studio stance; the thighs under the shorts are not seen.
accessories_seen: Silver chain with a large link/diamond-style necklace (UFC 322 face-off, November 2025); black caps, worn backwards or forwards, in the interview frames.

kit.typical_shorts: April 2026 studio portrait: white UFC shorts with a light-grey wave/scale print, black UFC waistband panel, black-and-white block pattern at the waistband sides, a Venum mark and green lettering down his LEFT leg. UFC Perth (May 2026, blue corner) and UFC 322 (November 2025, blue corner): white shorts with grey print and a black VENUM waistband tab.
kit.gloves: Black UFC 4 oz gloves in studio; blue cuffs at UFC Perth and UFC 322.
kit.brand_note: UFC-issued kit with a Venum mark.

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js). Ordinary ears with a slight stand-out, a pointed chin and lightly hollow cheeks. The lip volumes in morphs are set up on purpose: avatar3d's athleteTargets thins every male lip, which would lose his full lips.

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: a broad, rounded nose tip with wide alae on a straight, medium-height bridge, full upper and lower lips, heavy-lidded eyes with no inner-corner fold, and a long face with high cheekbones and a narrow pointed chin. Not assigned from name, nationality or heritage.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low: his features sit between the bases; check a render against the April 2026 headshot and drop or flatten the block if the face comes out too wide; the detail morphs work without it

render_hints.skin_base: middleage_caucasian_male (swatch #dab396) tinted toward tone_hex_recommended #ae7655: the closest swatch lighter than his tone, since the african swatches (#583724-#66402a) are darker than the sampled tone and the avatar tint can only darken. Texture picked by swatch colour only.
render_hints.hair: tight-curl strand shell about 3 cm on top over a high skin fade, #1c1512
render_hints.beard: thin pencil moustache plus a small chin goatee, #1e1611, over a faint stubble shadow
render_hints.tattoos: full sleeves on both arms, 'Muay Thai' chest script, throat monogram, left-neck script, left-scalp script, full back piece, DANGER on the left shin

notes: Confidence: high for skin tone range, hair, facial hair, tattoo placement and build; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 8 photos: 2 freely licensed (Commons CC BY 3.0 interview frames, September 2025 and April 2026), 6 reference-only; 4 are from 2026. One left profile (UFC 322 face-off, small) and a right three-quarter from the May 2026 fight photo; no true right profile. The two interview frames are close phone shots with wide-angle distortion (nose and lips exaggerated), so face proportions come from the April 2026 studio portraits. What to watch: (1) The likeness rests on the long face tapering to a narrow pointed chin, the heavy-lidded eyes, the broad nose tip with full lips, and the thin pencil moustache with a small goatee. (2) The tattoos are a major cue: both sleeves, the 'Muay Thai' chest script, the throat and left-neck pieces and the full back piece; mirror-check that the oni mask sits on his LEFT shoulder, the haloed cherub on his RIGHT arm and DANGER on his LEFT shin. (3) Build: tall, slim and very long-armed; do not bulk up the chest or arms. (4) Skin is a warm medium golden-brown; pick a lighter skin texture and tint it down rather than a darker texture. (5) His stance is listed as Switch on ufcstats. Macro values: ageOldM uses MakeHuman's 25-years-at-0.5, 90-years-at-1.0 mapping (age 33). heightUpM 0.2 matches other 185.4 cm fighters. l-/r- morphs are the character's own left and right.
